exposure: Parity (prior birth vs. no prior birth)
Maternal fertility status (fertile, subfertile, IVF with different oocyte sources and embryo states)
cohort: 1,477,522 pregnant women in 8 US states, including those who underwent IVF and a 10:1 sample of non-IVF pregnancies
finding: Compared to fertile women, subfertile women and women who conceived through IVF had an increased risk of severe maternal morbidities, particularly those related to blood transfusion, perineal laceration, and unplanned hysterectomy.
